rv.q: All The World is a charming love letter to theater, acting, and life, both onstage and off.
Thebus, who has directed Gunderson's work before in her impressive CV, is absolutely a perfect choice for this one.
Together with all the artists involved, they have conjured a real holiday treat at Northlight with simple tools— the English language, artistic excellence and storytelling par excellence.
Ros and Jake magical and amusing chemistry on stage is engaging, making you truly root for a successful offstage relationship in this romantic comedy-drama.
Escalante is particularly stunning in her commitment to her theatrical career.
This is a play that works well with Northlight and their new venue.
